setup: One camera, fixed for the whole session: about 3-4 m away at hip height, roughly 45 degrees between front and side of a clear area of about 4 x 3 m. The judge's whole body, and every prop being used, must stay in view. Good, even lighting. Floor and fall tasks are slow and controlled, on a mat: skip anything that isn't comfortable.
fields: tier: core (the essential set, about 25 tasks), extended, or edge (edge cases that stress the capture). stop: 'still' (default) ends the take once the judge has moved and then held still for still_s seconds (default 1.5); 'time' records for exactly max_s. still_s is raised for tasks with a deliberate pause. note: limitations to keep in mind when comparing with the sim.

tasks.name: Neutral stance
tasks.instruction: Stand still facing the camera, feet hip-width apart, arms relaxed at your sides.

tasks.name: T-pose
tasks.instruction: Stand facing the camera with your arms straight out to the sides in a T. Hold still.
tasks.note: Reference pose for scaling and retargeting a sim humanoid.

tasks.name: A-pose
tasks.instruction: Stand facing the camera with your arms held out about halfway, in an A shape. Hold still.

tasks.name: Side-on stance
tasks.instruction: Stand still side-on to the camera, arms relaxed.

tasks.name: Arms overhead
tasks.instruction: Stand facing the camera with both arms straight overhead. Hold still.

tasks.name: Range of motion
tasks.instruction: Slowly raise both arms forward and overhead, lower them, then bend forward and come back up. Stand still.

tasks.name: Walk and stop
tasks.instruction: Walk across the room, about 3 m, side-on to the camera. Then stop and stand still.

tasks.name: Walk there and back
tasks.instruction: Walk across the room, turn around, walk back to where you started, then stand still.

tasks.name: Walk toward the camera
tasks.instruction: From the far side, walk straight toward the camera and stop about 1.5 m away. Stand still.
tasks.note: Movement toward or away from the camera is the least accurate direction.

tasks.name: Walk away from the camera
tasks.instruction: From about 1.5 m in front of the camera, walk straight away to the far side. Stop and stand still.
tasks.note: Movement toward or away from the camera is the least accurate direction. Facing away from the camera, left and right can be confused for a moment.

tasks.name: Walk diagonally
tasks.instruction: Walk diagonally across the room, corner to corner. Stop and stand still.

tasks.name: Walk in a circle
tasks.instruction: Walk one full circle about 2 m across and end where you started. Stand still.
tasks.note: Facing away from the camera, left and right can be confused for a moment.

tasks.name: Walk very slowly
tasks.instruction: Walk across very slowly, as if you're carrying something fragile. Stop and stand still.

tasks.name: Walk briskly
tasks.instruction: Walk across briskly, as if you're late for a talk. Stop and stand still.

tasks.name: Walk backwards
tasks.instruction: Carefully walk backwards about 2 m. Stop and stand still.

tasks.name: Walk on tiptoe
tasks.instruction: Walk across on tiptoe. Stop and stand still.

tasks.name: March on the spot
tasks.instruction: March on the spot, knees high, for about 5 seconds. Then stand still.

tasks.name: Walk while on your phone
tasks.instruction: Walk across the room looking down at your phone. Stop and stand still.

tasks.name: Walk around a chair
tasks.instruction: Walk once around the chair and return to where you started. Stand still.
tasks.note: Facing away from the camera, left and right can be confused for a moment.

tasks.name: Walk with a full cup
tasks.instruction: Walk across carrying a full cup carefully in one hand. Stop and stand still.

tasks.name: Shuffle
tasks.instruction: Walk across with very short, shuffling steps. Stop and stand still.

tasks.name: Jog across
tasks.instruction: Jog across the room, staying in view, slow down, stop and stand still.
tasks.note: Has moments with both feet off the floor: height during those isn't recovered.

tasks.name: Run on the spot
tasks.instruction: Run on the spot for about 5 seconds, then stop and stand still.
tasks.note: Has moments with both feet off the floor: height during those isn't recovered.

tasks.name: High knees
tasks.instruction: Run on the spot bringing your knees up high, about 5 seconds. Then stand still.
tasks.note: Has moments with both feet off the floor: height during those isn't recovered.

tasks.name: Butt kicks
tasks.instruction: Jog on the spot kicking your heels up behind you, about 5 seconds. Then stand still.
tasks.note: Has moments with both feet off the floor: height during those isn't recovered.

tasks.name: Skip across
tasks.instruction: Skip across the room. Stop and stand still.
tasks.note: Has moments with both feet off the floor: height during those isn't recovered.

tasks.name: Hop on one foot
tasks.instruction: Hop 3 times on your right foot, then stand on both feet.
tasks.note: Has moments with both feet off the floor: height during those isn't recovered.

tasks.name: Jump on the spot
tasks.instruction: Jump straight up 3 times, then stand still.
tasks.note: Has moments with both feet off the floor: height during those isn't recovered.

tasks.name: Jump forward
tasks.instruction: Jump forward with both feet, about half a metre. Land and stand still.
tasks.note: Has moments with both feet off the floor: height during those isn't recovered.

tasks.name: Jump over a line
tasks.instruction: Jump over the tape line on the floor with both feet, then stand still.
tasks.note: Has moments with both feet off the floor: height during those isn't recovered.

tasks.name: Jump and turn
tasks.instruction: Jump and turn half way round in the air. Land and stand still.
tasks.note: Has moments with both feet off the floor: height during those isn't recovered. Facing away from the camera, left and right can be confused for a moment.

tasks.name: Side shuffle
tasks.instruction: Shuffle quickly sideways about 2 m and back. Stand still.

tasks.name: Turn around
tasks.instruction: Turn around on the spot, one full turn, and end facing the camera. Stand still.
tasks.note: Facing away from the camera, left and right can be confused for a moment.

tasks.name: Face away and back
tasks.instruction: Turn to face away from the camera, pause, then turn back. Stand still.
tasks.note: Facing away from the camera, left and right can be confused for a moment.

tasks.name: Pivot
tasks.instruction: Pivot on one foot a quarter turn to the left, then back. Stand still.

tasks.name: Side-step
tasks.instruction: Take 3 side-steps to your left, then 3 back to your right. Stand still.

tasks.name: Grapevine
tasks.instruction: Step sideways 4 steps, crossing one foot behind the other each time. Stand still.

tasks.name: Step forward and back
tasks.instruction: Take one big step forward, then step back to where you were. Stand still.

tasks.name: Step up
tasks.instruction: Step up onto the low, sturdy step with both feet, then step back down. Stand still.
tasks.note: Standing on the step looks like standing on the floor: the 3D doesn't know the step's height.

tasks.name: Step over a cable
tasks.instruction: Walk up to the cable or tape line on the floor, step over it, then stand still.
props: cable or tape line on the floor

tasks.name: Step over a box
tasks.instruction: Step over the low box on the floor, then stand still.

tasks.name: Stand on your left leg
tasks.instruction: Stand on your left leg for about 5 seconds, then put the other foot down.

tasks.name: Stand on your right leg
tasks.instruction: Stand on your right leg for about 5 seconds, then put the other foot down.

tasks.name: Heel-to-toe stance
tasks.instruction: Stand with one foot directly in front of the other, heel to toe, for about 5 seconds.

tasks.name: Shift your weight
tasks.instruction: Slowly shift your weight from side to side, 3 times. Then stand still.

tasks.name: Rise onto your toes
tasks.instruction: Rise up onto your toes and back down, 5 times. Then stand still.

tasks.name: Lean and reach
tasks.instruction: Without moving your feet, lean forward and reach as far as you can. Then stand straight.

tasks.name: Lean on a wall
tasks.instruction: Walk to the wall, lean on it with one shoulder for a few seconds, then stand up straight.
tasks.note: Support from furniture isn't in the 3D: the sim won't see that force.

tasks.name: Sit down
tasks.instruction: Start standing in front of the chair. Sit down and stay seated.

tasks.name: Stand up
tasks.instruction: Start seated on the chair. Stand up and stay standing.

tasks.name: Sit down without hands
tasks.instruction: Cross your arms over your chest and sit down on the chair. Stay seated.

tasks.name: Stand up without hands
tasks.instruction: Start seated with your arms crossed. Stand up without using your hands.

tasks.name: Sit-to-stand x3
tasks.instruction: Stand up and sit down 3 times, ending seated. Stay still.

tasks.name: Stand up pushing on knees
tasks.instruction: Start seated. Stand up by pushing on your knees with your hands.

tasks.name: Edge of the seat
tasks.instruction: Seated, slide to the front edge of the chair, then sit back and lean back. Stay still.

tasks.name: Cross your legs
tasks.instruction: Seated, cross one leg over the other, then uncross it. Stay still.

tasks.name: Reach to the floor seated
tasks.instruction: Seated, reach down and touch the floor beside the chair, then sit up straight.

tasks.name: Slouch and sit up
tasks.instruction: Seated, slouch down in the chair, then sit up straight. Stay still.

tasks.name: Scoot a wheeled chair
tasks.instruction: Seated on a wheeled chair, scoot forward about 1 m with your feet. Stop.
tasks.note: The object being sat on or held isn't tracked: the sim needs a matching prop.

tasks.name: Swivel in a chair
tasks.instruction: Seated on a swivel chair, turn half way round and back. Stay still.
tasks.note: The object being sat on or held isn't tracked: the sim needs a matching prop. Facing away from the camera, left and right can be confused for a moment.

tasks.name: Pull out a chair and sit
tasks.instruction: Pull the chair out from the table, sit down, and pull yourself in to the table.
tasks.note: The table hides the legs: expect low leg visibility.

tasks.name: Stand and push the chair in
tasks.instruction: Stand up from the table and push the chair back in. Stand still.

tasks.name: Sit on a stool
tasks.instruction: Sit down on the stool, then stand back up. Stand still.

tasks.name: Sit on a beanbag
tasks.instruction: Drop onto the beanbag or low seat, then get back up. Stand still.
tasks.note: The object being sat on or held isn't tracked: the sim needs a matching prop.

tasks.name: Shoe off and on
tasks.instruction: Seated, take one shoe off and put it back on.
tasks.note: Finger and small head movements aren't tracked; arms and posture are.

tasks.name: Sit on the floor
tasks.instruction: From standing, sit down cross-legged on the floor. Stay still.

tasks.name: Stand up from the floor
tasks.instruction: Start sitting cross-legged on the floor. Stand up and stay standing.

tasks.name: Lie down
tasks.instruction: From standing, lie down on your back on the mat. Stay still.

tasks.name: Get up from lying
tasks.instruction: Start lying on your back on the mat. Get up to standing, then stand still.

tasks.name: Lie face down
tasks.instruction: From standing, lie face down on the mat. Stay still.

tasks.name: Get up from face down
tasks.instruction: Start lying face down on the mat. Get up to standing, then stand still.

tasks.name: Lie on your side
tasks.instruction: From standing, lie down on your side on the mat. Stay still.

tasks.name: Get up from your side
tasks.instruction: Start lying on your side on the mat. Get up to standing, then stand still.

tasks.name: Roll over
tasks.instruction: Lying on your back, roll onto your front, then back again. Stay still.

tasks.name: Hands and knees
tasks.instruction: Get down onto your hands and knees, hold for a moment, then stand up.

tasks.name: Crawl
tasks.instruction: Crawl on your hands and knees about 2 m, then stand up. Stand still.

tasks.name: Stand up from kneeling
tasks.instruction: Start kneeling on both knees. Stand up and stay standing.

tasks.name: Half-kneel
tasks.instruction: Go down into a half-kneel with one knee on the floor, hold, then stand up.

tasks.name: Get up from long-sitting
tasks.instruction: Start sitting on the floor with your legs straight out in front. Get up to standing.

tasks.name: Get up using a chair
tasks.instruction: Start sitting on the floor next to a chair. Use the chair to help you stand up.
tasks.note: Support from furniture isn't in the 3D: the sim won't see that force.

tasks.name: Stand up from the floor without hands
tasks.instruction: From sitting cross-legged, stand up without using your hands, if you comfortably can.

tasks.name: Down and up quickly
tasks.instruction: Lie down on your back, then get up again as quickly as you comfortably can. Stand still.

tasks.name: Controlled fall forward
tasks.instruction: From standing, lower yourself forward onto your hands and knees on the mat, like a slow fall. Stay still.
tasks.note: Slow and controlled, onto the mat. Skip if it isn't comfortable.

tasks.name: Controlled fall sideways
tasks.instruction: From standing, lower yourself sideways onto the mat, like a slow fall. Stay still.
tasks.note: Slow and controlled, onto the mat. Skip if it isn't comfortable.

tasks.name: Controlled fall backwards
tasks.instruction: From standing, slowly sit back onto the mat as if falling backwards, controlled. Stay still.
tasks.note: Slow and controlled, onto the mat. Skip if it isn't comfortable.

tasks.name: Catch a stumble
tasks.instruction: Pretend to trip: take a quick big step forward to catch your balance. Stand still.

tasks.name: Catch a bump
tasks.instruction: Pretend you were bumped from the side: take a quick side-step to catch your balance. Stand still.

tasks.name: Fall and get up
tasks.instruction: Lower yourself slowly to the mat any way you like, then get back up. Stand still.
tasks.note: Slow and controlled, onto the mat. Skip if it isn't comfortable.

tasks.name: Get up from hands and knees
tasks.instruction: Start on your hands and knees on the mat. Get up to standing, then stand still.

tasks.name: Get up from a slump
tasks.instruction: Start sitting slumped on the floor against the wall. Get up to standing.
tasks.note: Support from furniture isn't in the 3D: the sim won't see that force.

tasks.name: Get up from face down with a chair
tasks.instruction: Start lying face down next to a chair. Use the chair to help you get up.
tasks.note: Support from furniture isn't in the 3D: the sim won't see that force.

tasks.name: Type on a laptop
tasks.instruction: Sitting at the table, type on the laptop for the whole recording.
tasks.note: Finger and small head movements aren't tracked; arms and posture are. The table hides the legs: expect low leg visibility.

tasks.name: Type standing up
tasks.instruction: Standing at the table, type on the laptop for the whole recording.
tasks.note: Finger and small head movements aren't tracked; arms and posture are.

tasks.name: Open and close a laptop
tasks.instruction: Standing at the table, open the laptop, close it again, step back and stand still.

tasks.name: Carry a laptop
tasks.instruction: Pick the laptop up from the table, walk across the room holding it open, then stand still.

tasks.name: Plug in a charger
tasks.instruction: Crouch down, plug a charger into the power strip on the floor, then stand back up.

tasks.name: Reach under the desk
tasks.instruction: Crouch and reach under the table as if plugging in a cable, then come out and stand up.
tasks.note: The table hides the legs: expect low leg visibility.

tasks.name: Coil a cable
tasks.instruction: Unplug a cable, coil it up, and put it on the table. Stand still.
tasks.note: Finger and small head movements aren't tracked; arms and posture are.

tasks.name: Drink from a cup
tasks.instruction: Pick up the cup from the table, take a sip, put it back, then stand still.

tasks.name: Eat a snack
tasks.instruction: Pick up a snack from the table, eat a bite, put the rest down. Stand still.

tasks.name: Write on paper
tasks.instruction: Sitting at the table, write on paper for the whole recording.
tasks.note: Finger and small head movements aren't tracked; arms and posture are. The table hides the legs: expect low leg visibility.

tasks.name: Check your phone seated
tasks.instruction: Seated, take out your phone, scroll for a few seconds, put it away. Stay still.
tasks.note: Finger and small head movements aren't tracked; arms and posture are.

tasks.name: Adjust a monitor
tasks.instruction: Standing at the table, tilt and turn the monitor, then step back. Stand still.

tasks.name: Lean on the desk
tasks.instruction: Lean on the table with both hands, looking at the screen, then stand up straight.
tasks.note: Support from furniture isn't in the 3D: the sim won't see that force.

tasks.name: Nap on the desk
tasks.instruction: Sitting at the table, lean forward and rest your head on your folded arms. Stay still.
tasks.note: The table hides the legs: expect low leg visibility.

tasks.name: Pick up from the floor
tasks.instruction: Bend down, pick up the object from the floor, and stand back up.

tasks.name: Two ways to lift
tasks.instruction: Pick up the box twice: once bending your knees, once bending at the waist. Stand still.

tasks.name: Lift a box onto a table
tasks.instruction: Lift the box from the floor, place it on the table, step back and stand still.

tasks.name: Take a box off a table
tasks.instruction: Take the box off the table, put it down on the floor, then stand up straight.

tasks.name: Lift a box up high
tasks.instruction: Lift the box from the table up onto a high shelf, or hold it overhead for a moment, then lower your arms.

tasks.name: Carry a box
tasks.instruction: Pick up the box, carry it across the room, about 3 m, put it down and stand still.
tasks.note: The object can hide the arms and chest.

tasks.name: Carry a box in one hand
tasks.instruction: Carry the small box across the room in one hand, at your side. Stand still.

tasks.name: Carry a box on your shoulder
tasks.instruction: Lift the box onto one shoulder and carry it across the room. Put it down, stand still.
tasks.note: The object can hide the arms and chest.

tasks.name: Carry a box toward the camera
tasks.instruction: Carry the box from the far side straight toward the camera. Put it down, stand still.
tasks.note: The object can hide the arms and chest. Movement toward or away from the camera is the least accurate direction.

tasks.name: Carry two boxes
tasks.instruction: Carry two light boxes stacked in your arms across the room, only if you can still see over them. Put them down.
tasks.note: The object can hide the arms and chest.

tasks.name: Push a box
tasks.instruction: Push the box along the floor, about 2 m, with both hands, then stand up straight.
props: box with some weight in it

tasks.name: Drag a box
tasks.instruction: Drag the box backwards along the floor, about 2 m, then stand up straight.
props: box with some weight in it

tasks.name: Stack boxes
tasks.instruction: Stack the two boxes on top of each other, then stand still.

tasks.name: Unstack boxes
tasks.instruction: Take the top box off the stack and put it on the floor beside it. Stand still.

tasks.name: Move a chair
tasks.instruction: Pick up the chair, move it about 2 m, set it down and stand still.

tasks.name: Carry two bags
tasks.instruction: Carry a bag in each hand across the room, like suitcases. Put them down, stand still.

tasks.name: Carry something long
tasks.instruction: Carry a broom or pole horizontally across the room. Put it down, stand still.

tasks.name: Reach overhead
tasks.instruction: Reach up high with one hand, as if taking something off a shelf, then lower your arm.

tasks.name: Reach down low
tasks.instruction: Crouch and take something from a low shelf or the floor in front of you, then stand up.

tasks.name: Reach across a table
tasks.instruction: Reach across the table for an object on the far side, then stand up straight.
tasks.note: The table hides the legs: expect low leg visibility.

tasks.name: Wipe a table
tasks.instruction: Wipe the table with a cloth for a few seconds, then stand up straight.

tasks.name: Sweep
tasks.instruction: Sweep the floor with a broom for a few seconds, then stand still.

tasks.name: Throw and catch
tasks.instruction: Throw a soft ball up and catch it, 3 times, then stand still.

tasks.name: Throw into a bin
tasks.instruction: Throw a paper ball into the bin from about 2 m away. Stand still.

tasks.name: Roll a ball
tasks.instruction: Crouch and roll a ball along the floor, then stand up.

tasks.name: Kick a ball
tasks.instruction: Kick a soft ball gently, then stand still.

tasks.name: Pass between hands
tasks.instruction: Pass an object from one hand to the other, behind your back and then in front. Stand still.

tasks.name: Hang up a coat
tasks.instruction: Hang a coat on the hook or rack, then stand still.

tasks.name: Put trash in the bin
tasks.instruction: Pick up the paper from the floor, walk to the bin and drop it in. Stand still.

tasks.name: Tidy the desk
tasks.instruction: Gather the things on the table into one pile. Stand still.

tasks.name: Backpack on and off
tasks.instruction: Put your backpack on, then take it off and put it on the floor. Stand still.

tasks.name: Put on a jacket
tasks.instruction: Put on the jacket. Stand still.

tasks.name: Take off a jacket
tasks.instruction: Take off the jacket and hold it. Stand still.

tasks.name: Put on a hoodie
tasks.instruction: Pull a hoodie on over your head. Stand still.
tasks.note: The head is covered for a moment: head joints are guessed then.

tasks.name: Hat on and off
tasks.instruction: Put on a hat, then take it off. Stand still.

tasks.name: Headphones on and off
tasks.instruction: Put on headphones, then take them off. Stand still.

tasks.name: Put on a badge
tasks.instruction: Put a lanyard badge over your head. Stand still.

tasks.name: Kneel and tie a shoe
tasks.instruction: Kneel down on one knee, tie your shoelace (or pretend to), then stand back up.
tasks.note: Finger and small head movements aren't tracked; arms and posture are.

tasks.name: Wave
tasks.instruction: Wave with your right hand for about 3 seconds, then lower it.

tasks.name: Wave both hands
tasks.instruction: Wave both hands over your head for about 3 seconds, then lower them.

tasks.name: Clap
tasks.instruction: Clap your hands about 5 times, then lower them.

tasks.name: Thumbs up
tasks.instruction: Give two thumbs up, hold for a moment, then lower your hands.
tasks.note: Finger and small head movements aren't tracked; arms and posture are.

tasks.name: Point
tasks.instruction: Point at something across the room, hold, then lower your arm.

tasks.name: Come here
tasks.instruction: Wave someone over to you with your hand, a few times, then lower it.

tasks.name: Shrug
tasks.instruction: Shrug your shoulders with your palms up, then relax.

tasks.name: Take a bow
tasks.instruction: Take a bow, as after a demo, then stand up straight.

tasks.name: Raise your hand
tasks.instruction: Raise your hand as if asking a question, hold, then lower it.

tasks.name: Hands on hips
tasks.instruction: Put your hands on your hips, hold, then relax.

tasks.name: Phone call
tasks.instruction: Hold your phone to your ear as if on a call for about 3 seconds, then lower it.

tasks.name: Take a selfie
tasks.instruction: Hold your phone out at arm's length, pose for a moment, then lower it.

tasks.name: Check the time
tasks.instruction: Raise your wrist and look at your watch, then lower it.

tasks.name: Facepalm
tasks.instruction: Put your hand over your face, hold, then lower it.
tasks.note: The hand hides the face: head joints are less reliable.

tasks.name: Scratch your head
tasks.instruction: Scratch your head as if thinking, then lower your hand.

tasks.name: Nod and shake your head
tasks.instruction: Nod yes, then shake your head no.
tasks.note: Finger and small head movements aren't tracked; arms and posture are.

tasks.name: Present and point
tasks.instruction: Point at the wall or screen beside you and gesture as if explaining, for about 5 seconds, then lower your arms.

tasks.name: Write on a whiteboard
tasks.instruction: Write on the whiteboard for about 5 seconds, then step back and stand still.

tasks.name: Erase a whiteboard
tasks.instruction: Erase the whiteboard with big sweeps, then step back and stand still.

tasks.name: Show your screen
tasks.instruction: Hold your laptop up and turn it round to show the screen to an audience. Lower it.
tasks.note: The object can hide the arms and chest.

tasks.name: Pitch while pacing
tasks.instruction: Pace back and forth as if pitching your project, gesturing as you talk. Then stop.

tasks.name: Speak into a mic
tasks.instruction: Hold a microphone (or a bottle) to your mouth and gesture with your other hand.

tasks.name: Overhead stretch
tasks.instruction: Stretch both arms overhead, as after hours of coding, hold for a moment, then lower them.

tasks.name: Yawn and stretch
tasks.instruction: Yawn and stretch your whole body, as after an all-nighter. Then relax.

tasks.name: Side bend
tasks.instruction: Lean to the left, then to the right, then stand straight.

tasks.name: Shoulder rolls
tasks.instruction: Roll your shoulders backwards 3 times, then stand still.

tasks.name: Neck rolls
tasks.instruction: Slowly roll your head in a circle, once each way.
tasks.note: Finger and small head movements aren't tracked; arms and posture are.

tasks.name: Touch your toes
tasks.instruction: Bend forward and reach for your toes, then stand up straight.

tasks.name: Quad stretch
tasks.instruction: Stand on one leg and pull your other foot up behind you, hold, then switch legs.

tasks.name: Hamstring stretch
tasks.instruction: Put one heel forward, lean over that leg, hold, then stand up straight.

tasks.name: Arm across stretch
tasks.instruction: Pull one arm across your chest, hold, then switch arms.

tasks.name: Torso twist
tasks.instruction: Twist your upper body left and right a few times, then stand still.

tasks.name: Lean back
tasks.instruction: Put your hands on your lower back and lean back gently, then stand straight.

tasks.name: Calf stretch
tasks.instruction: Push against the wall with one leg back and the heel down, hold, then stand straight.
tasks.note: Support from furniture isn't in the 3D: the sim won't see that force.

tasks.name: Squats
tasks.instruction: Do 3 slow squats, then stand still.

tasks.name: Jump squats
tasks.instruction: Do 3 jump squats, then stand still.
tasks.note: Has moments with both feet off the floor: height during those isn't recovered.

tasks.name: Lunges
tasks.instruction: Do 2 lunges on each leg, then stand still.

tasks.name: Push-ups
tasks.instruction: Do 3 push-ups side-on to the camera, then stand up and stay still.

tasks.name: Knee push-ups
tasks.instruction: Do 3 push-ups on your knees, side-on to the camera, then stand up.

tasks.name: Plank
tasks.instruction: Get into a plank, hold it for about 5 seconds, then get up and stand still.
tasks.note: Fixed length because the hold itself is still.

tasks.name: Side plank
tasks.instruction: Get into a side plank, hold it for about 5 seconds, then get up.

tasks.name: Burpees
tasks.instruction: Do 2 burpees, then stand still.
tasks.note: Has moments with both feet off the floor: height during those isn't recovered.

tasks.name: Mountain climbers
tasks.instruction: Do mountain climbers for about 5 seconds, then stand up.

tasks.name: Sit-ups
tasks.instruction: Lying on your back, do 3 sit-ups, then get up and stand still.

tasks.name: Glute bridge
tasks.instruction: Lying on your back with knees bent, lift your hips up and down 3 times, then get up.

tasks.name: Wall sit
tasks.instruction: Lean your back on the wall and slide down into a sitting position, hold, then stand up.
tasks.note: Support from furniture isn't in the 3D: the sim won't see that force.

tasks.name: Arm circles
tasks.instruction: Make big circles with both arms, about 5 seconds, then lower them.

tasks.name: Jumping jacks
tasks.instruction: Do 5 jumping jacks, then stand still.
tasks.note: Has moments with both feet off the floor: height during those isn't recovered.

tasks.name: Celebrate
tasks.instruction: You just won: jump with both arms up and celebrate, then stand still.
tasks.note: Has moments with both feet off the floor: height during those isn't recovered.

tasks.name: Dance
tasks.instruction: Dance freely for about 5 seconds, then stop and stand still.

tasks.name: Fist pump
tasks.instruction: Pump your fist in the air 3 times, then lower it.

tasks.name: Victory pose
tasks.instruction: Raise both arms in a V and hold, then lower them.

tasks.name: Lift the trophy
tasks.instruction: Lift an imaginary trophy over your head, hold it, then lower it.

tasks.name: Spin around
tasks.instruction: Spin round once with your arms out, then stand still.
tasks.note: Facing away from the camera, left and right can be confused for a moment.

tasks.name: Air guitar
tasks.instruction: Play air guitar for about 5 seconds, then stand still.

tasks.name: The demo failed
tasks.instruction: Act disappointed: slump your shoulders and hang your head, then straighten up.

tasks.name: Too close to the camera
tasks.instruction: Stand about 1 m from the camera so your feet are cut off. Raise and lower your arms.
tasks.note: Part of the body is out of view: those joints are guessed.

tasks.name: Half out of view
tasks.instruction: Stand at the left edge so half your body is out of view, then wave. Stand still.
tasks.note: Part of the body is out of view: those joints are guessed.

tasks.name: Reach out of view
tasks.instruction: Stand close enough that your raised hands leave the top of the picture. Reach up, then lower your arms.
tasks.note: Part of the body is out of view: those joints are guessed.

tasks.name: Walk into view
tasks.instruction: Start out of view. Walk into the middle of the picture, stop and stand still.

tasks.name: Walk out of view
tasks.instruction: Walk out of view to the side. The recording runs for a fixed time.
tasks.note: The judge leaves the picture: frames after that have no data.

tasks.name: Back to the camera
tasks.instruction: Facing away from the camera the whole time, raise both arms, then lower them.
tasks.note: Facing away from the camera, left and right can be confused for a moment.

tasks.name: Walk behind a table
tasks.instruction: Walk behind the table so it hides your legs, stop and stand still.
tasks.note: The table hides the legs: expect low leg visibility.

tasks.name: Crouch out of sight
tasks.instruction: Crouch down behind the table until you're mostly hidden, then stand back up.
tasks.note: Part of the body is out of view: those joints are guessed.

tasks.name: Hide behind a box
tasks.instruction: Hold a big box in front of your chest, hold still, then put it down. Stand still.
tasks.note: The object can hide the arms and chest.

tasks.name: Arms crossed
tasks.instruction: Cross your arms, hold, then uncross them.

tasks.name: Hands behind your back
tasks.instruction: Put your hands behind your back, hold, then bring them forward.
tasks.note: The hands are hidden: arm joints behind the body are guessed.

tasks.name: Hands in pockets
tasks.instruction: With your hands in your pockets, walk a few steps and stop. Stand still.

tasks.name: Hood up
tasks.instruction: With your hood up, turn your head left and right, then stand still.
tasks.note: The hood hides the ears: head joints are less reliable.

tasks.name: Loose clothing
tasks.instruction: Wearing a long coat or a blanket around your shoulders, sit down and stand up.
tasks.note: Loose clothing hides the body's outline: joints can drift.

tasks.name: Lie with feet toward the camera
tasks.instruction: Lie on your back with your feet toward the camera, then get up.
tasks.note: Movement toward or away from the camera is the least accurate direction.

tasks.name: Lie with head toward the camera
tasks.instruction: Lie on your back with your head toward the camera, then get up.
tasks.note: Movement toward or away from the camera is the least accurate direction.

tasks.name: Dim light
tasks.instruction: With a light turned off or dimmed, do one squat, then stand still.
tasks.note: Low light adds noise: tracking is less stable.

tasks.name: Very slow movement
tasks.instruction: Raise both arms overhead extremely slowly, over about 10 seconds, then lower them the same way.
tasks.note: Very slow movement can look like standing still.

tasks.name: Very fast punches
tasks.instruction: Throw quick punches in the air for about 3 seconds, then stand still.
tasks.note: Fast movement blurs: wrists can lag or jump.

tasks.name: Freeze mid-squat
tasks.instruction: Squat half way down, freeze for 3 seconds, then stand up and stand still.

tasks.name: Wait, then act
tasks.instruction: Stand still for about 5 seconds, then wave, then stand still again.

tasks.name: Fidget
tasks.instruction: Stand and fidget: shift your feet, touch your face, adjust your clothes.

tasks.name: Tap your foot
tasks.instruction: Only tap one foot, for the whole recording.
tasks.note: Tiny movement: may be close to tracking noise.

tasks.name: Shadow-box
tasks.instruction: Shadow-box continuously for the whole recording.

tasks.name: Sudden stop
tasks.instruction: Jog on the spot, then stop dead and hold completely still.
tasks.note: Has moments with both feet off the floor: height during those isn't recovered.

tasks.name: Fast sit-to-stand
tasks.instruction: Stand up and sit down as fast as you comfortably can, 3 times, ending seated.

tasks.name: Move freely for 30 s
tasks.instruction: Move around the area freely, any way you like, for about 30 seconds. Then stop.

tasks.name: Someone walks behind you
tasks.instruction: While you wave, a second person walks across the room behind you.
tasks.note: A second person is in view: click the judge to lock tracking before starting. Only the judge is recorded.

tasks.name: Someone walks in front of you
tasks.instruction: While you raise and lower your arms, a second person walks between you and the camera.
tasks.note: A second person is in view: click the judge to lock tracking before starting. Only the judge is recorded. The judge is fully hidden for a moment.

tasks.name: Next to someone
tasks.instruction: Stand next to a second person. Only you do a squat.
tasks.note: A second person is in view: click the judge to lock tracking before starting. Only the judge is recorded.

tasks.name: Walk past someone
tasks.instruction: Walk across the room past a second person who is standing still.
tasks.note: A second person is in view: click the judge to lock tracking before starting. Only the judge is recorded.

tasks.name: High five
tasks.instruction: Walk to the second person, give them a high five, then step back and stand still.
tasks.note: A second person is in view: click the judge to lock tracking before starting. Only the judge is recorded.

tasks.name: Hand something over
tasks.instruction: Hand an object to the second person, then step back and stand still.
tasks.note: A second person is in view: click the judge to lock tracking before starting. Only the judge is recorded.

tasks.name: Swap places
tasks.instruction: You and a second person swap places, crossing paths. Stand still.
tasks.note: A second person is in view: click the judge to lock tracking before starting. Only the judge is recorded. Tracking can switch people when paths cross.

tasks.name: Busy background
tasks.instruction: Do a squat while several people move around in the background.
tasks.note: A second person is in view: click the judge to lock tracking before starting. Only the judge is recorded.

tasks.name: Walk with a cane
tasks.instruction: Walk across using a cane, or an umbrella as a cane. Stop and stand still.
tasks.note: Support from furniture isn't in the 3D: the sim won't see that force.

tasks.name: Walk with a stiff knee
tasks.instruction: Walk across keeping your right knee straight, as if in a brace. Stop.

tasks.name: Stand up holding a chair
tasks.instruction: Start sitting on the floor. Stand up holding the back of a chair for support.
tasks.note: Support from furniture isn't in the 3D: the sim won't see that force.

tasks.name: Push a wheelchair
tasks.instruction: If a wheelchair is available: sit in it and push yourself about 2 m forward. Stop.
tasks.note: The object being sat on or held isn't tracked: the sim needs a matching prop.

tasks.name: Walk with crutches
tasks.instruction: If crutches are available: walk across using them. Stop and stand still.
tasks.note: Support from furniture isn't in the 3D: the sim won't see that force.
